facts: Planning Data provides a single API interface across more than 100 planning and housing datasets for England
The API supports coordinate queries using latitude and longitude
Coordinate queries return entities whose geometry intersects the supplied point for selected datasets
The entity endpoint supports JSON, HTML and GeoJSON extensions
The API supports multiple dataset parameters in one coordinate request
The API documentation says absence of results does not mean no planning constraints exist because coverage varies
The API supports geometry_entity filters for spatial queries
The API supports spatial relations including within, intersects, covers and overlaps
Coordinates for geometry queries should use WGS84 EPSG:4326
The API documentation recommends bulk downloads for large portfolios to avoid rate limits and create stable snapshots
Planning Data dataset downloads can include CSV, JSON, GeoJSON and Parquet where applicable
Planning Data's site-allocation consideration defines site allocations as areas identified for future housing, employment, retail or green-space development
The site-allocation consideration is currently in Co-design stage
The site-allocation consideration lists no related dataset
Planning Data states this consideration was deprioritised in April 2025 while focus moved to local plans more broadly
Planning Data research classifies site allocation as an output created during the local-plan process
The site-allocation consideration therefore cannot currently be assumed to be a standard coordinate-query dataset
Planning Data separately provides an authoritative development-plan-document-type entity named Site allocations
That Site allocations entity is a category and contains no geometry
The development-plan-document-type dataset currently contains 16 types
The type catalogue explicitly includes site-allocations
The type catalogue collector last ran on 27 July 2026
Planning Data states the document-type data is created by MHCLG pending replacement by authoritative sources when available
A site-allocations document type is taxonomy and not site polygon membership
The local-plan dataset contains current, emerging and historical plans
The local-planning-authority dataset provides authority entities usable for spatial filtering
The development-plan-document dataset can identify site-allocation documents but not candidate geometry by document type alone
Planning Data coordinate semantics are useful only for datasets that actually expose relevant geometry coverage
No site-allocation membership is inferred from API capability, taxonomy or dataset counts
No new exact relation is promoted from Planning Data in this wave
